eventMetadata.context_description: Recent military exchanges in late July 2026, including Iranian strikes on commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz and subsequent U.S. responses, have strained the interim ceasefire framework established in April and the June memorandum of understanding. That MoU set a 60-day window for addressing navigation rights, sanctions relief, nuclear issues, and Lebanon deconfliction, yet violations prompted President Trump to declare the truce over on July 8 while signaling openness to continued talks. On July 31, orders for renewed U.S. strikes against Iranian targets raised immediate risks of further escalation. Traders are monitoring any diplomatic signals from mediators, nuclear inspection mechanisms, or de-escalation steps that could restore a verifiable pause in hostilities within coming weeks.
